title: Policy evaluation errors
description: The OPA evaluation throws or returns an undefined decision.
callerVisible: Protected requests are declined with a human route; safety and human routes stay available.
backendEvidence: Deny by default on policy error
Audit event with policy-error reason code

registry.injectionPoint: the in-process OPA evaluation throws or is undefined

postconditions: A policy evaluation that throws or returns an undefined decision fails closed with POLICY_ENGINE_ERROR for every protected read and action
No protected data is returned and no consequential action is prepared or committed while the engine fails
Safety and human routes stay allowed (SAFE-02)
Each denial is a durable audit event carrying POLICY_ENGINE_ERROR
